access.suspended_notice: You have been suspended from Crimson-Police for {days} day(s).
access.unsuspended_notice: Your Crimson-Police suspension has been lifted.
err.busy: Still working on your last request. Wait a moment and try again.
err.in_arena: You can't take a mission while you are in the arena. Leave the arena first.
err.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.invalid_days: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 3650.
err.invalid_payload: That request was not valid. Close the tablet, open it again and retry.
err.invalid_run: That run could not be found. It may have ended: refresh the screen.
err.invalid_ui: That screen does not exist. Close the tablet and open it again.
err.no_permission: You don't have permission to do that. Ask a supervisor or an admin if you think you should.
err.no_response: No response from the server. Wait a moment and try again.
err.not_admin: Only admins can open the Admin UI. Ask a server admin if you need access.
err.not_started: Crimson-Police did not start, so it cannot answer. A server admin must check the server console.
err.not_in_game: This can only be used in game. Join the server and try again.
err.not_on_duty: You need to be on duty to use Crimson-Police. Go on duty first.
err.not_police: Crimson-Police is only for officers whose active job belongs to a department. Switch to your police job first.
err.not_supervisor: Only supervisors can open the Supervisor UI. Use the Officer UI instead.
err.other_department: That belongs to another department, so you can't act on it.
err.own_run: You (or one of your characters) took part in this run, so you can't review it.
err.rate_kick: You were removed from the server for sending too many tablet requests. Wait a moment, then rejoin.
err.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
err.refused: The server refused that request. Refresh the screen to see what changed, then try again.
err.suspended: You are suspended from Crimson-Police. A supervisor can tell you when it ends.
err.suspended_dispatch: You are suspended in SC-Dispatch and cannot use Crimson-Police. A supervisor can tell you when it ends.
err.tablet_closed: The tablet was closed before that screen opened. Open the tablet again.
err.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Wait a moment and try again.
err.unknown_action: That action is not available. Refresh the screen.
err.unknown_department: That department is not known. Pick a department from the list.
